title: Bitcoin ETF outflows accelerate as IBIT logs record withdrawals
summary: Bitcoin ETFs log fifth straight day of heavy outflows. BlackRock’s IBIT posts record withdrawal since launch. Bitcoin risks further downside as sell pressure intensifies. US-listed spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds saw another day of significant redemptions on 18 November, marking their fifth consecutive session of outflows.
